name: Minimum active-power relay
summary: A minimum active-power relay operates according to a configured low active-power condition.
description: A minimum active-power relay operates according to a configured low active-power condition. The measurement direction and enable logic determine what low power means in the control sequence.
readingNotes: Identify the directional convention before evaluating the threshold.
